summary: Dependabot bump of the decision-jevlike base image from python:3.11-slim to python:3.15-slim, plus a fix of a pre-existing build failure. The new digest sha256:65a65fc7b30b06cb6df4930fd4650697cb23f4c2698ab81fc87e4b031bc36928 equals the current index digest of python:3.15-slim on Docker Hub (pushed 2026-11-07), so the reference stays immutable (ADR-0055). The build ran pip install git+https://github.com/vinnylarouge/jevlike@<commit>, but slim images contain no git, so it failed on every base (reproduced with the unchanged 3.11 Dockerfile and with 3.15); jevlike now comes from the archive of the same pinned commit (https://github.com/vinnylarouge/jevlike/archive/94f5fd1b0b11d52bbdfdf4e0ee6aa96b568f8452.tar.gz), which needs no git and is as pinned as before (same commit, same host). Built with podman on python:3.15-slim: Python 3.15.2, torch 2.15.0+cpu (cp315 wheel from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu), numpy 2.5.5; every import server.py needs (torch, jevlike.data, jevlike.model, jevlike.train) works. Offline variables, the loopback-only port binding in compose.yaml, the /models volume and the entrypoint are unchanged. No new trust boundary, port, credential or network destination at runtime.

findings.evidence: A third-party base image and a pinned third-party package are fetched at build time.
findings.resolution: Pre-existing and unchanged in scope: the base image stays pinned by digest (verified against the registry) and jevlike stays pinned to the same commit; only the transport changes from git to the commit archive of the same host.

findings.evidence: Found in this review: the image could not be built at all (git missing in python:*-slim), so a rebuild for a security fix would have failed.
findings.resolution: Install from the pinned commit archive; image built and imports checked on python:3.15-slim.

tests.command: Docker Hub registry HEAD /v2/library/python/manifests/3.15-slim (index media types)
tests.evidence: Docker-Content-Digest sha256:65a65fc7b30b06cb6df4930fd4650697cb23f4c2698ab81fc87e4b031bc36928, identical to the pinned digest.

tests.command: podman build decision-jevlike (unchanged main Dockerfile on python:3.11-slim, and PR head on python:3.15-slim)
tests.evidence: Both failed before the fix with: Cannot find command 'git' - reproduces the pre-existing failure independent of the Python version.

tests.command: podman build decision-jevlike with the archive URL on python:3.15-slim, then python -c 'import torch, jevlike; from jevlike.model import load_checkpoint, select_device; from jevlike.data import ChoiceExample; from jevlike.train import move'

limitations: The service was not started with a real checkpoint; the router CT's image is only replaced when the operator rebuilds and restarts the jevlike service.
python:3.15-slim was pushed on 2026-11-07; the operator's 7-day minimum image age is reached on 2026-11-14.
